name: ERA Realty
summary: Established agency brand with islandwide residential coverage for rentals and purchases.
body: ERA agents frequently appear in expat rental searches and purchase shortlists. For rentals, ask specifically about HDB eligibility if that is on your shortlist — rules trip up newcomers weekly. For purchases, insist the agent state your ABSD rate by nationality on the OTP date, whether FTA remission applies (US / Iceland / Liechtenstein / Norway / Switzerland), and that ABSD is cash not loanable. Interview the individual agent on contract hygiene and response time; logo scale is not a substitute for a clean LOI/OTP process.
